concerns.text: FR-005 in spec.md requires the connectivity‑strength metric to be the **signed** average of Pearson correlations (preserving sign). Task T017 computes a **mean absolute** correlation, thereby weakening the functional requirement and contradicting the spec.

FR-011 (both Inclusion and Exclusion time‑series must be present for each retained subject) is not covered by any task. No verification step ensures that subjects lacking one condition are excluded from the paired analysis.
FR-014 (exclude a subject if extraction fails for any required DMN ROI) is absent. There is no task that checks ROI‑extraction success and drops failing subjects from downstream steps.
SC-001 (≥ 80 % subject retention after QC) has no verification or test in the task list, so the success criterion cannot be measured.
SC-002 (stability of permutation‑test p‑values across seeds) is not addressed; no task runs the permutation test with multiple seeds nor computes the required standard deviation.
SC-006 (report mean ± SD of dynamic connectivity‑strength series per subject) is missing. T018 outputs raw window‑wise series but no summary statistics are generated.

FR-019 (confound regression) appears in the plan and tasks (T014) but is **not** defined in the specification. Introducing this step without a spec entry constitutes unapproved scope creep, violating constitutional principle of no silent constitution drift.

Because the spec’s FR-005 explicitly demands sign‑preserving averaging, computing a mean absolute correlation (as T017 does) weakens the requirement and fails to satisfy the functional requirement as written.
